_comment: Model capability profiles for thinking-aware routing. Layered: built-in defaults (benny/core/model_profiles.py) < this file < <workspace>/.benny/model_profiles.json (Agents screen). thinking: 'capable' = reasons but safe to /no_think (auto-suppressed for synthesis); 'fragile' = /no_think EMPTIES it, never suppress (FLM family); 'none' = not a reasoning model. Select the active profile per provider in 'providers'.

default.description: Auto-suppress hidden reasoning for synthesis on thinking-capable models; never suppress fragile FLM models.

always-think.description: Never auto-suppress (reasoning-quality / debug mode). Operator per-model overrides still apply.
